                .child('cosmetics').child(newData.val()).exists()) &&

nameChangeToken..write:
auth != null && auth.uid === $uid && data.exists() &&
            !data.child('usedAt').exists() &&
            newData.child('cost').val() === data.child('cost').val() &&
            newData.child('purchasedAt').val() === data.child('purchasedAt').val() &&
            newData.child('usedAt').isNumber()

$name..write:
auth != null && ((!newData.exists() && data.val() === auth.uid) ||
          (!data.exists() && newData.val() === auth.uid &&
          $name.matches(/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{2,11}$/) &&
          !$name.matches(/.*(admin|administrator|moderator|support|staff|official).*/) &&
          !$name.matches(/.*(system|root|owner|developer|fuck|cunt).*/) &&
          !$name.matches(/.*(asshole|bastard|bitch|whore|slut|shit).*/)))

$name..validate:
!newData.exists() ||
          (newData.hasChildren(['username', 'rating', 'tier', 'wins', 'losses']) &&
          newData.child('username').isString() && newData.child('username').val().length >= 3 &&
          newData.child('username').val().length <= 12 && newData.child('rating').isNumber() &&
          newData.child('rating').val() >= 0 && newData.child('rating').val() <= 10000 &&
          newData.child('tier').isString() && newData.child('wins').isNumber() &&
          newData.child('wins').val() >= 0 && newData.child('losses').isNumber() &&
          newData.child('losses').val() >= 0 &&
          newData.child('rating').val() ===
            root.child('users').child(root.child('usernames').child($name).val())
              .child('rating').val() &&
          newData.child('wins').val() ===
            root.child('users').child(root.child('usernames').child($name).val())
              .child('wins').val() &&
          newData.child('losses').val() ===
            root.child('users').child(root.child('usernames').child($name).val())
              .child('losses').val())

tier..validate:
newData.isString() &&
            newData.val() === (newData.parent().child('rating').val() >= 2000 ? 'Master' :
            newData.parent().child('rating').val() >= 1800 ? 'Platinum' :
            newData.parent().child('rating').val() >= 1500 ? 'Gold' :
            newData.parent().child('rating').val() >= 1000 ? 'Silver' :
            newData.parent().child('rating').val() >= 500 ? 'Bronze' : 'Novice')

$inviteId..write:
auth != null && ((!data.exists() &&
            newData.child('fromUid').val() === auth.uid && auth.uid !== $uid) ||
            (!newData.exists() && (auth.uid === $uid ||
              data.child('fromUid').val() === auth.uid)))
$inviteId..validate:
newData.hasChildren(['fromUid', 'fromName', 'roomCode', 'sentAt']) &&
            newData.child('fromUid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('fromName').isString() &&
            newData.child('fromName').val().length >= 1 &&
            newData.child('fromName').val().length <= 12 && newData.child('roomCode').isString() &&
            newData.child('roomCode').val().matches(/^[0-9]{6}$/) &&
            newData.child('sentAt').isNumber()
